parameters.query:
-- Latest issued bill for a customer, across all their supplies.
-- Dates cast to text so they reach the agent as YYYY-MM-DD, untouched by timezones.
SELECT
    c.customer_code,
    c.first_name,
    s.type              AS supply_type,
    s.meter_code,
    b.amount,
    b.period_start::text,
    b.period_end::text,
    b.due_date::text,
    b.status,
    b.issued_on::text
FROM customers c
JOIN supplies  s ON s.customer_id = c.id
JOIN bills     b ON b.supply_id   = s.id
WHERE c.customer_code = $1
ORDER BY b.issued_on DESC, b.id DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  found: true,
  customer_code: $json.customer_code,
  first_name: $json.first_name,
  supply_type: $json.supply_type,
  meter_code: $json.meter_code,
  amount_eur: Number($json.amount),
  period: { from: $json.period_start, to: $json.period_end },
  due_date: $json.due_date,
  status: $json.status,
  issued_on: $json.issued_on
} }}
